result.brief: 提出基于3D高斯原语的行动条件世界模型：SplatWAM-T 将无位姿多视图编码为固定预算高斯 token，SplatWAM-D 单次前向预测未来高斯状态，并联合训练流匹配策略头，实现实时可渲染的3D想象与策略学习。
result.reason: Action-conditioned world model over 3D Gaussian tokens with a tokenizer and dynamics model; main contribution is embodied world modeling and policy, so secondary application direction.
